title: Acyclic replacement and pointwise boundaries for a colimit-site coefficient system
statement:
Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small
categories, and $P_j$ a precoverage on $F(j)$ with isomorphisms, composition stability,
base-change stability and covering pullbacks [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].
Every covering is finite. The transition functors preserve coverings and pullbacks
along covering arrows, are continuous, and their inverse images on sets preserve
finite limits and finite colimits. Let $V$ be a cocone whose objects and arrows are
colimits of those of $F$, and let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same axioms,
whose coverings are exactly the images of stage coverings [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites].
The cocone functors preserve coverings and covering pullbacks, are continuous, and
their inverse images on sets preserve finite limits and finite colimits. All inverse
images on abelian sheaves are additive, and all sheaf categories have the indicated
Ext groups. Suppose supplied transition and cocone pullback maps on $H^q(X,A)$ are
natural in $A$, commute with every short exact sequence's connecting homomorphism,
and are the adjunction-unit maps in degree zero [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback].
Let $e_{a,b}$ and $e^V_a$ be inverse-image composition isomorphisms compatible with
the adjunction units. Let $\mathcal F_j$ be abelian sheaves and
$\varphi_a:a^*\mathcal F_j\to\mathcal F_k$ for $a:j\to k$, satisfying the cocycle
through $e_{a,b}$. Let $S:J\to\mathrm{Ab}(Q)$ have objects $V_j^*\mathcal F_j$
and maps $e^V_a$ followed by $V_k^*\varphi_a$, with explicit transported equalities.
Let $K$ be a colimit cocone of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i\in J$,
$X_i\in F(i)$, $n\geq0$, and write $X_t=F(t.hom)(X_i)$,
$U_t=V_{t.right}(X_t)$, and $U=V_i(X_i)$ for $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$.
All equalities of arrows with varying endpoints are equalities in the arrow category.
For any specified equalities $h_t:U_t=U$, there exist compatible
coefficients $\mathcal R_j,\varphi^R_a$, an inverse-image diagram $S_R$, and a colimit
cocone $K_R$ with the analogous object, map and cocycle equations. Their degree-$n$
identity transition maps are identities on every $H^n(X,\mathcal R_j)$.
There exist an abelian sheaf $G$ and a short exact sequence
$E=(K.pt\xrightarrow{f}G\xrightarrow{g}K_R.pt)$ such that
$H^q(W,G)=0$ for every $W\in V.pt$ and $q>0$.
The Yoneda-product boundary is returned as a homomorphism $d:H^n(U,K_R.pt)\to H^{n+1}(U,K.pt)$, with its pointwise formula $d(x)=x\circ [E]$. There exist homomorphisms $\beta_t:H^n(X_t,\mathcal R_{t.right})\to
H^{n+1}(X_t,\mathcal F_{t.right})$ whose composites with the original canonical
stage-to-$K.pt$ maps, transported along $h_t$, equal the canonical stage-to-$K_R.pt$
maps, transported along $h_t$, followed by Yoneda multiplication by $[E]$.
No degree-$n$ stage diagram, comparison cocone, or surjectivity conclusion is included.

proof.text: Identify identity inverse image with the identity functor compatibly with the adjunction unit. The identity coefficient action is idempotent by hφ. Split its image and restrict transitions, obtaining a unital normalized coefficient system. By S.map_id, hSmap and unit coherence, the inverse-image diagram of this system identifies with S. Transpose the normalized transitions via adjunction; their cocycle follows from hφ and he. Apply exists_compatible_injective_system and transpose back to get compatible monomorphisms into injective stage sheaves. The normalized inclusions into the original coefficients will later define β with the original cohomology endpoint; no isomorphism on original stage cohomology is required.

Take the stage cokernels of the compatible monomorphisms. Exact inverse image induces their transition maps; cancel the cokernel epimorphisms to prove the cocycle. Form SR from their colimit-site inverse images, with the stated object and arrow equalities, and choose a colimit KR. Exact filtered colimits of abelian sheaves make 0 → K.pt → G → KR.pt → 0 short exact.

By hQ each colimit-site covering comes from a finite stage covering. The Cech comparison expresses the complex for G as a filtered colimit of the stage injective complexes. Stage Cech acyclicity and exact filtered colimits make it positively acyclic. The Cech vanishing criterion applied to all objects yields positive object-cohomology vanishing of G.

The normalized coefficient system and its injective system are unital. Cokernel cancellation makes the cokernel system unital as well. The degree-zero characterization and uniqueness of site cohomology pullback imply that its degree-n identity pullback followed by the coefficient identity induces the identity. This gives hidR, needed to construct a genuine lower-degree stage diagram.

At each stage take the Yoneda-product boundary of the normalized short exact sequence, and follow it by cohomology of the normalized inclusion into the original coefficients. This defines β_t with the original cohomology endpoint, without requiring identity actions on the original stage cohomology. The connecting compatibility of canonicalMap and naturality of Ext classes for the map into the colimit sequence identify β_t followed by the original comparison with the replacement comparison followed by E.extClass. Transport both comparisons along the specified h_t. These are boundaries on actual cohomology groups, not on supplied diagrams.

    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})

      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), PreservesFiniteLimits
      (sheafPullback (F.map a).toFunctor (Type u)
        (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck)]
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), PreservesFiniteColimits

    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))

    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderComposition] [Q.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : ∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔

        (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
        S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R)
    (hVcover : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      R.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor ∈ Q ((V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hVpullback : ∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor)
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    [∀ j : J, PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback (V.ι.app j).toFunctor (Type u)

    [∀ j : J, PreservesFiniteColimits (sheafPullback (V.ι.app j).toFunctor (Type u)

    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),

        (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck).Additive]
    [∀ j : J, (sheafPullback (V.ι.app j).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).Additive]
    [∀ j : J, HasExt.{u} (Sheaf (P j).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    [HasExt.{u} (Sheaf Q.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (pullbackMap : ∀ {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k) (q : ℕ) (X : F.obj j)

      Sheaf.H' A q X ⟶ Sheaf.H' ((sheafPullback (F.map a).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck).obj A) q ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullbackMap : ∀ {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k),
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (X : F.obj j) (A A' : Sheaf (P j).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (φ : A ⟶ A'),
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (P j).toGrothendieck p).map φ).app (op X) ≫
            pullbackMap a p X A' =
          pullbackMap a p X A ≫
            ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (P k).toGrothendieck p).map

            (((Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x).hom.app (op X)).hom

    (canonicalMap : ∀ (j : J) (q : ℕ) (X : F.obj j)
      (A : Sheaf (P j).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
      Sheaf.H' A q X ⟶ Sheaf.H' ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app j).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj A) q ((V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hcanonicalMap : ∀ (j : J),
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (X : F.obj j) (A A' : Sheaf (P j).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (φ : A ⟶ A'),

      (∀ (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf (P j).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})) (hS : S.ShortExact)
        (hS' : (S.map (sheafPullback (V.ι.app j).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck)).ShortExact)
        (p : ℕ) (X : F.obj j) (x : Sheaf.H' S.X₃ p X),

        ((Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ ((canonicalMap j 0 X A).hom x)).hom.app (op ((V.ι.app

                j).toFunctor.obj X))).hom
                (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 ((V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X)))) =
          (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app j).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
            (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app A).hom.app (op X)).hom
            (((Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x).hom.app (op X)).hom
              (((toSheafify (P j).toGrothendieck
                (yoneda.obj X ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op X)).hom
                  (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 X))))))
    (e : ∀ {j k l : J} (a : j ⟶ k) (b : k ⟶ l),

      (sheafPullback (V.ι.app j).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}

    (hSmapR : ∀ {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k),
      Arrow.mk (SR.map a) = Arrow.mk ((eV a).hom.app (FsR j) ≫
        (sheafPullback (V.ι.app k).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (P k).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).map (φR a)))
    (KR : Cocone SR) (hKR : IsColimit KR)
    (hidR : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j),
      Arrow.mk (pullbackMap (𝟙 j) n X (FsR j) ≫
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (P j).toGrothendieck n).map
          (φR (𝟙 j))).app (op ((F.map (𝟙 j)).toFunctor.obj X))) =
        Arrow.mk (𝟙 (Sheaf.H' (FsR j) n X)))
    (G : Sheaf Q.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (f : K.pt ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ KR.pt) (w : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hE : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    (d : Sheaf.H' KR.pt n ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj X_i) ⟶
      Sheaf.H' K.pt (n + 1) ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj X_i)),
      (∀ x, d.hom x = Abelian.Ext.comp x hE.extClass rfl) ∧
      (∀ (U : V.pt) (q : ℕ), 0 < q → IsZero (Sheaf.H' G q U)) ∧
      ∃ β : ∀ t : Under i,
        Sheaf.H' (FsR t.right) n ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X_i) ⟶
          Sheaf.H' (Fs t.right) (n + 1) ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X_i),
        ∀ t : Under i,
          β t ≫ (canonicalMap t.right (n + 1)
          ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X_i) (Fs t.right) ≫
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor Q.toGrothendieck (n + 1)).map
          (eqToHom (hSobj t.right).symm ≫ K.ι.app t.right)).app
            (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X_i)))) ≫
              eqToHom (congrArg (Sheaf.H' K.pt (n + 1)) (hU t)) =
            (canonicalMap t.right n
          ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X_i) (FsR t.right) ≫
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor Q.toGrothendieck n).map
          (eqToHom (hSobjR t.right).symm ≫ KR.ι.app t.right)).app
            (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X_i)))) ≫
              eqToHom (congrArg (Sheaf.H' KR.pt n) (hU t)) ≫
              d
